title: mnemonica lineage graph
description: The shared lineage export format (draft 1). Instance ids are implementation-specific; cross-language comparison maps them 1:1 in first-encounter order (see testdata/lineage/README.md).

heads.description: Ids of the exported instances, in argument order.

nodes.description: Every reachable instance, deduplicated at any depth, keyed by id.

type.description: The level's type: where it was declared, not just its name (names collide).

own.description: The fields this level's own struct declares: shadowed values stay with their writer. Embedded parents and the lineage header never appear here.

parent.description: The parent's id, or null at the root.

args.description: Construction args — present only when the WithArgs option is given.

props.description: Opt-in metadata (e.g. timestamp) — present only when WithProps is given.

value.description: A JSON-safe value: instances export as $ref, non-JSON values as tagged placeholders.

anyOf.description: An instance reference: the target joins nodes with its own chain.
Tagged placeholder for a value JSON cannot carry (funcs, channels, NaN, infinities, complex numbers, cycles, non-string map keys). Never an error.
A plain nested value (structs, maps with string-or-integer keys).
